tools.name: ninety_auth_status
tools.title: Ninety connection status
tools.description: Check whether a Ninety Personal Access Token is configured and working. Verifies the token by listing the teams it can access.

tools.name: ninety_teams
tools.title: List Ninety teams
tools.description: List all Teams the authenticated user belongs to (id and name).

tools.name: ninety_teams_available
tools.title: List teams available for creating work
tools.description: List the Teams the authenticated user may pick when creating or querying work — their own teams plus, for Owners/Admins/Implementers, every non-private team. Each is flagged with isMember.

tools.name: ninety_users
tools.title: List Ninety users
tools.description: List every active User in the company with role, teams, and email — useful for resolving a name to the userId that create/assign endpoints accept. Filter to one person with the email parameter.

email.description: Return only the User at this email (case-insensitive)

tools.name: ninety_team_users
tools.title: Get the users on a team
tools.description: List the Users assigned to a Team, ordered by name, with role and team memberships.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

tools.name: ninety_user_get
tools.title: Get a Ninety user
tools.description: Get a User by Id (name and primary email). To search by name or email, use ninety_users.

tools.name: ninety_todos_query
tools.title: Query Ninety To-Dos
tools.description: List To-Dos matching filters. Returns an array of To-Dos (title, description, dueDate, completed, archived, teamId/teamName, userId).

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

isPersonal.description: Only personal To-Dos (not tied to a team)

searchText.description: Match against To-Do title and description

userIds.description: Filter by assignee user Ids. Omit alongside teamId to get the whole team's To-Dos.

dueDateFrom.description: Earliest due date to return, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive

dueDateTo.description: Latest due date to return, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive

paged.description: true returns {items, totalCount} pagination metadata instead of a bare array

tools.name: ninety_todo_get
tools.title: Get a Ninety To-Do
tools.description: Get a single To-Do by Id.

tools.name: ninety_todo_create
tools.title: Create a Ninety To-Do
tools.description: Create a To-Do. Omit teamId for a personal To-Do.

teamId.description: Team to assign the To-Do to; omit for a personal To-Do

userId.description: User to assign to; defaults to the authenticated user

linkedItemId.description: Id of a Rock, Issue, or Milestone to link this To-Do to (requires linkedItemType)

tools.name: ninety_todo_update
tools.title: Update a Ninety To-Do
tools.description: Partially update a To-Do — only the fields provided are changed.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

userId.description: Reassign the To-Do to this user

linkedItemId.description: Id of a Rock, Issue, or Milestone to link this To-Do to (requires linkedItemType)

tools.name: ninety_todo_delete
tools.title: Delete a Ninety To-Do
tools.description: Permanently delete a To-Do by Id.

tools.name: ninety_todos_company
tools.title: List company-wide To-Dos
tools.description: List every non-personal To-Do across the whole company (Owners/Admins only), cursor-paginated. Pass the previous response's pagination.nextToken to get the next page.

nextToken.description: Cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextToken

searchText.description: Match against title, description, and comments

tools.name: ninety_todo_comment
tools.title: Comment on a To-Do
tools.description: Append one comment to a To-Do, attributed to the authenticated user. Returns the full comment list.

tools.name: ninety_todo_link
tools.title: Link a To-Do to a Rock, Issue, or Milestone
tools.description: Create a link between an existing To-Do and an existing Rock, Issue, or Milestone without changing the To-Do's own fields.

linkedItemId.description: Id of the Rock, Issue, or Milestone to link to

tools.name: ninety_todo_unlink
tools.title: Remove a To-Do link
tools.description: Remove an existing link between a To-Do and a Rock, Issue, or Milestone.

linkedItemId.description: Id of the linked Rock, Issue, or Milestone

tools.name: ninety_issues_query
tools.title: Query Ninety Issues
tools.description: Paginated list of Issues. Returns items plus totalCount. Issues are SHORT_TERM (weekly/session) or LONG_TERM (ongoing).

teamId.description: A team Id or comma-separated team Ids; omit to query all teams

searchText.description: Match against title, description, and comments

tools.name: ninety_issue_get
tools.title: Get a Ninety Issue
tools.description: Get a single Issue by Id.

tools.name: ninety_issue_create
tools.title: Create a Ninety Issue
tools.description: Create an Issue for a team.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

userId.description: User to assign the Issue to; defaults to the authenticated user

tools.name: ninety_issue_update
tools.title: Update a Ninety Issue
tools.description: Partially update an Issue — only the fields provided are changed. Set completed=true to resolve it.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

tools.name: ninety_issue_delete
tools.title: Delete a Ninety Issue
tools.description: Permanently delete an Issue by Id.

tools.name: ninety_issues_company
tools.title: List company-wide Issues
tools.description: List every non-archived, non-deleted Issue across the whole company (Owners/Admins only), cursor-paginated. Pass the previous response's pagination.nextToken to get the next page.

nextToken.description: Cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextToken

searchText.description: Match against title, description, and comments

tools.name: ninety_issue_comment
tools.title: Comment on an Issue
tools.description: Append one comment to an Issue, attributed to the authenticated user. Returns the full comment list.

tools.name: ninety_rocks_query
tools.title: Query Ninety Rocks
tools.description: List Rocks (quarterly goals), grouped by teamId, with paging. Each Rock includes its milestones. futureScope filters the planning horizon; pass "all" to span every scope.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

archived.description: true for archived Rocks only; default active only

includeRockGoals.description: Include linked goals in the response

paged.description: true returns a flat {items, totalCount} page instead of Rocks grouped by teamId

tools.name: ninety_rock_get
tools.title: Get a Ninety Rock
tools.description: Get a single Rock by Id, including its milestones, comments, and attachments.

tools.name: ninety_rock_create
tools.title: Create a Ninety Rock
tools.description: Create a Rock (quarterly goal) owned by the authenticated user. statusCode defaults to ON_TRACK, levelCode to USER, quarter to None.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

additionalTeamIds.description: Other teams that can view this Rock

tools.name: ninety_rock_update
tools.title: Update a Ninety Rock
tools.description: Partially update a Rock — only the fields provided are changed. Set statusCode=DONE to complete it, archived=true to archive.

userId.description: Reassign the Rock to this user

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

tools.name: ninety_rock_delete
tools.title: Delete a Ninety Rock
tools.description: Soft-delete a Rock by Id. Returns the deleted Rock.

tools.name: ninety_rocks_company
tools.title: List company-wide Rocks
tools.description: List every non-archived, non-deleted Rock across the whole company (Owners/Admins only), cursor-paginated. Pass the previous response's pagination.nextToken to get the next page.

nextToken.description: Cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextToken

tools.name: ninety_rock_milestones
tools.title: List a Rock's Milestones
tools.description: Get all Milestones for a Rock by its Id.

tools.name: ninety_milestone_get
tools.title: Get a Ninety Milestone
tools.description: Get a single Milestone by Id. To list a Rock's milestones, use ninety_rock_milestones.

tools.name: ninety_milestone_create
tools.title: Create a Ninety Milestone
tools.description: Create a Milestone on a Rock.

rockId.description: The Rock this Milestone belongs to

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

toDoId.description: Id of a related To-Do, if any

isDone.description: true if already done at creation

completedDate.description: ISO 8601; required when isDone is true

tools.name: ninety_milestone_update
tools.title: Update a Ninety Milestone
tools.description: Partially update a Milestone — only the fields provided are changed. Set isDone=true (with completedDate) to complete it. The public API has no milestone delete endpoint.

completedDate.description: ISO 8601; provide when setting isDone to true

ownedByUserId.description: Reassign the Milestone to this user

tools.name: ninety_kpis_query
tools.title: Query Ninety Measurables (KPIs)
tools.description: Paginated list of Scorecard Measurables with metadata: _id, title, unit, currency, periodInterval, defaultGoal, owner, isSmart (formula-based — never write scores to these), isUsedInFormula, lastScoreUpdatedAt, teams, scorecards. For score VALUES use ninety_team_scorecard or ninety_get_score.

teamId.description: Limit to Measurables on this Team's Scorecards

searchText.description: Match against Measurable title or description

tools.name: ninety_team_scorecard
tools.title: Read a Team's Scorecard
tools.description: Read a Team's Scorecard — its Measurables WITH their score values, notes, and goals — for a window of periods. Every score is labelled with the period as Ninety displays it; select periods by matching those labels. Use date to get the single period containing that calendar date.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

periodInterval.description: Which of the Team's Scorecards to read (default weekly)

window.description: Window of periods to return (default: the most recent 13 periods). Ignored when date is set.

date.description: Return only the single period containing this calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: ninety_get_score
tools.title: Read one Measurable's score
tools.description: Read a single Measurable's score for the period containing the given date. Prefer this over ninety_team_scorecard when only one number is needed. value is null when no score is recorded for that period (not an error).

date.description: Any calendar date inside the target period (YYYY-MM-DD); it is snapped to the period

tools.name: ninety_update_score
tools.title: Update a score, note, or period goal
tools.description: Update a Measurable's score, note, and/or custom goal for one period in a single call. Supply at least one of value, note, goal; omitted fields are unchanged and null clears a field. The goal is a per-period override only — it does not change the Measurable's default goal.

periodStartDate.description: Any calendar date within the target period (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime)

goal.description: Per-period goal override, e.g. {"value": 100} or a range {"min": 90, "max": 110}; null removes it

tools.name: ninety_put_score
tools.title: Set a Measurable score
tools.description: Create or update the score for a Measurable (KPI) for a period. An existing score for that period is silently overwritten. Never write to formula-based (isSmart) Measurables — they compute from other Measurables. A Measurable with isUsedInFormula=true feeds downstream calculated Measurables.

periodStartDate.description: Period start date, ISO 8601 — the first day of the period, e.g. "2026-07-01" or "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z". For monthly Measurables this is the first of the month; for weekly, the first day of the week.

tools.name: ninety_put_note
tools.title: Set a Measurable note
tools.description: Create or update the note on a Measurable (KPI) for a period. An existing note for that period is overwritten.

periodStartDate.description: Period start date, ISO 8601 — the first day of the period, e.g. "2026-07-01" or "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z". For monthly Measurables this is the first of the month; for weekly, the first day of the week.

tools.name: ninety_delete_score
tools.title: Delete a Measurable score
tools.description: Delete the score for a Measurable (KPI) for a given period start date.

periodStartDate.description: Period start date, ISO 8601 — the first day of the period, e.g. "2026-07-01" or "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z". For monthly Measurables this is the first of the month; for weekly, the first day of the week.

tools.name: ninety_delete_note
tools.title: Delete a Measurable note
tools.description: Delete the note on a Measurable (KPI) for a given period start date.

periodStartDate.description: Period start date, ISO 8601 — the first day of the period, e.g. "2026-07-01" or "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z". For monthly Measurables this is the first of the month; for weekly, the first day of the week.

tools.name: ninety_meeting_next
tools.title: Get a Team's next Meeting
tools.description: Get the soonest upcoming Meeting for a Team, with its agenda sections and roster. Only the near term is considered, so a 404 means nothing is scheduled soon — not that the Team never meets.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

tools.name: ninety_meetings
tools.title: List a Team's past Meetings
tools.description: List a Team's concluded Meetings, most recent first, with attendee ratings, duration, and Issues worked. meetingType filters to one kind per call (level10 is the Weekly Meeting).

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

meetingType.description: Which kind of Meeting to return (level10 = Weekly Meeting)

tools.name: ninety_meeting_get
tools.title: Get one Meeting
tools.description: Get one concluded Meeting with the notes taken during it and the Headlines, cascading messages, Issues, To-Dos, and Rocks it worked. Notes are the only free-text record of what was decided.

tools.name: ninety_vto
tools.title: Get a Team's V/TO
tools.description: Get a Team's Vision/Traction Organizer alongside the leadership team's: Core Values, Core Focus, 1-Year Plan, and 3-Year Picture. Unshared leadership sections come back empty.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

tools.name: ninety_accountability_chart
tools.title: Get the Accountability Chart
tools.description: Get the company's Accountability Chart: every Seat, its responsibilities, and who sits in it, ordered top-down. Use it to answer who owns an area of the business.

seatIds.description: Scope the chart to these Seats plus their ancestor chains

tools.name: ninety_headlines
tools.title: List a Team's Headlines
tools.description: List the Headlines on one Team's list — the short good/bad-news notes raised in Meetings. Already discussed Headlines are left out unless includeDiscussed is true. Set isCascadedMessage to list Cascading Messages instead.

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

isCascadedMessage.description: Return Cascading Messages instead of Headlines

archived.description: Return archived Headlines instead of active ones

searchText.description: Free-text search across title and body

tools.name: ninety_headline_create
tools.title: Create a Headline
tools.description: Create a Headline on one Team's list, exactly as one created in the app, notifying its followers.

title.description: The Headline itself, one line of plain text

teamId.description: Team Id (24-char hex). List teams with ninety_teams.

userId.description: User the Headline is about; defaults to the authenticated user

isCascadedMessage.description: Create a Cascading Message instead of a Headline

tools.name: ninety_request
tools.title: Raw Ninety API request
tools.description: Call any Ninety public API endpoint directly — the escape hatch for endpoints not covered by the typed tools or added to the API after this connector was built. The path is relative to https://api.public.ninety.io and should start with /v1/. GET /v1/swagger.json returns the live OpenAPI spec if you need to discover new endpoints. Requests are authenticated with the configured Personal Access Token and retried automatically on 429 rate limits.
